The following events took place in '''378 BBY'''.

==Events==
*The [[Kushiban]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ikrit]] travels to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and discovers the [[Golden Globe]], an ancient device created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] to imprison the souls of [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] children. Realizing that only [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children can release the captive souls, Ikrit enters a [[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trance]] to wait for help to arrive.<ref name="EGF74">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
